description: This file defines the AutoFilter class used in the PhpSpreadsheet library to read and handle auto-filter data from ODS spreadsheet files. It contains methods to parse XML elements, extract filter range attributes, and set auto-filters on the active sheet.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and applying auto-filter information from an ODS spreadsheet XML node.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Initiates reading of auto-filters from the provided workbook data XML element.

methods.name: readAutoFilters
methods.description: Parses the 'database-ranges' elements to identify and set auto-filters based on their target ranges.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the specified attribute value from a DOM node if it exists.
